deploybot: deploy-check failed for release v2026.03.21 - blocking promotion. Reason: header-name mismatch between staging and prod (staging: "X-Infer-Cache" vs prod: "X-Model-Cache"). Potential cache key split for inference caches.
Sam: ack, which service/chart?
deploybot: service=inference-router, chart=infra/inference@3.2.x, values.staging.headers.cacheName=X-Infer-Cache, values.prod.headers.cacheName=X-Model-Cache
Marta: ouch. That would create two independent cache namespaces — expect a huge cold-cache spike and token cost surge on promotion.
Julian: pulling logs from the canary - relevant lines: 
```
2026-03-21T10:12:03Z inference-router[canary] cache_miss key=X-Infer-Cache:sha256:abcd1234
2026-03-21T10:12:08Z inference-router[canary] cache_miss key=X-Infer-Cache:sha256:efgh5678
```
oncall_sre: @Sam @Marta ping — change window starts in ~2h. Do we hotfix staging to match prod, or hold the release and rollback the canary?
Sam: prefer a fast hotfix to staging values so we keep parity, then rerun deploycheck. Rolling back the canary would be slower and we'd still have configuration drift.
Marta: agree but ensure we pin the chart/image for the release after the fix so we don't accidentally roll forward a mismatched overlay.
Julian: lookup: header key introduced in infra/inference chart change in chart tag v3.2.1. Staging got an old overlay from the feature branch that never pulled the upstream values override.
Sam: I'll push a staging patch and run smoke tests. Patch plan: 
```
# quick helm patch to staging
helm upgrade inference-router infra/inference \
  --namespace staging \
  --reuse-values \
  --set headers.cacheName=X-Model-Cache \
  --set image.tag=2026.03.21-canary
```
Sam: running patch now...
ci-bot: deployment started: inference-router (staging) image=2026.03.21-canary — pods rolling update
deploybot: re-run deploy-check in 30s...
Julian: I also recommend pinning values in the release manifest: add `headers.cacheName: X-Model-Cache` to the release YAML to avoid overlays from dev branches sneaking in.
Marta: also plan to backfill cache warmup for prod to avoid cold start surge. We can run a lightweight synthetic traffic job to populate common prefixes.
release_manager: holding promotion to prod until we confirm parity and smoke tests pass. Update release notes: add "staging headerName mismatch discovered and fixed; promotion delayed".
Sam: smoke tests passed for basic routing and a subset of heavy prompts. Deploy-check returned green.
ci-bot: deploy-check: PASSED for inference-router (staging) at 2026-03-21T10:24:05Z
deploybot: releasehold cleared? awaiting approval from release_manager.
release_manager: approved to proceed with promotion only after we add a release pin and a one-hour canary in prod with cache warmup. Documenting in notes and tagging the release: pinned-chart=infra/inference@3.2.1; pinned-values.headers.cacheName=X-Model-Cache
Marta: I'll schedule the cache warmup job to run right after canary promotion. Script snippet: 
```
python tools/cache_warmup.py --service inference-router --count 5000 --concurrency 20 --header-name X-Model-Cache
```
Sam: doing final commit to release branch with pinned values and a brief playbook in /ops/release-playbooks/cache-warmup.md
Julian: leaving a short postmortem note: root cause was stale overlay applied to staging from a long-lived feature branch. Recommend adding a CI lint that checks header value parity across envs.
oncall_sre: +1 to parity lint. For now, change window still on, proceed with pinned promotion and warmup.
release_manager: marking release window: will promote in 40 minutes, run 1h prod canary, then full rollout if no anomalies. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks all.
Marta: nice catch deploybot :eyes:
